# vs.izie.top

> izie's hosted side projects.

## Docs

- [ReDocumented](https://vs.izie.top/redocumented/llms.txt): Slack Web API reference covering ~323 documented methods and ~1,941 undocumented or internal ones, with per-method JSON/markdown, a greppable index and OpenAPI.

## Apps

- [DeGoogledDict](https://vs.izie.top/dgd/): a dictionary card in the style of Google's "define" result, without AI text. Wiktionary or Merriam-Webster definitions, Datamuse synonyms, Wikipedia links.
- [Chesentir](https://vs.izie.top/Chesentir/): a fictional cheese platform. Satire; simulated agent and metrics.
- [ChopChop](https://vs.izie.top/ChopChop/): ChopChop YSWS parody landing page. Nothing is submitted anywhere.
